detail.longDescription: Solid’s AI agents build apps, automate workflows and tackle work you lack the time or expertise for. They pick and set up their own real machines, create accounts and pay for services. They use your apps through APIs or log in like a person. They build what’s missing and fix problems along the way. Think beyond personal agents like Grok Bot and Muse: Solid is built for complex, long-running work for you and your team. Close your laptop. Solid owns the job from start to finish.
